eras.note: Nebraska's single unicameral chamber is classified as the upper chamber (SLDU) in Census/TIGER data. Signed by Gov. Ricketts; no redraw since. Chamber is officially nonpartisan (49 senators) — the app's composition data currently shows 48; the constitutionally correct total is 49.
